#652 · Spiny Armor Pokémon

Chesnaught

Grass Fighting

Kalos · Generation 6

Chesnaught is a Grass/Fighting-type Spiny Armor Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 1.6 m tall and weighs 90 kg. It evolves from Quilladin. Its highest base stat is Defense (122), with a base stat total of 530.
